remarks: Light, bright Contemporary/Ranch with incredible water views of the LI Sound. Enjoy Compo Beach life and take in the spectacular sunrises and sunsets from the warmth of the sunroom or the sundrenched deck. Open floor plan, bathed in natural light, where you can gaze out at the LI Sound from the expanse of windows. A modern Poggenpohl kitchen with stainless appliances opens to a rear terrace with grill and outdoor dining space with a secret garden feeling. Tranquil Master Suite with sitting area, spa like bath, and private deck. Three more spacious bedrooms with hardwood floors, built-ins for work at home space, and full bath complete the bedroom wing. Beautiful private property with outdoor shower. Close to Compo beach and the premier Longshore Park with dining, golf, pool, boating, tennis, marina. Only minutes to the train station, and town center with all of Westport's amenities. Live, work, play at the beach and make memories that will last a lifetime! The monthly rent of $18,500 is for a 12 month lease. Shorter term rental rates are Seasonally adjusted.
